first_principles_question: Holding the R13 writer, exact R12 initialization, data, schedule, endpoint, and causal evaluation fixed, can symmetric own-versus-wrong-donor ranking supply the missing event-specific credit assignment so each image supports its own SET value but not another event's value?

activation.r13_outcome: technical pass, scientific fail: train normal accuracy reached 1.0 but only 14/36 train targets passed all causal gates; held-out pass counts were 1/24, 5/24, and 6/24, with donor/base frequently correct

dev_final.construction: one segment per dev target value, balanced 6/6/6/6 positions, with entities disjoint from train and both R12 dev subsets

writer_input: visible event_text through frozen R12 event feature extractor
training_loss_may_use: frozen Reader CE for the anchor query/target under its own image

writer.initialization: exact algebraic decomposition of the R12 conditioned step-1152 endpoint
writer.fixed_base: blank latent plus the R12 conditioned mean training coefficient projected through the R12 endpoint basis
writer.feature_extractor: frozen R12 conditioned step-1152 token LayerNorm and attention pooling
writer.coefficient_network: R12 conditioned step-1152 2048-512-48 MLP initialization; bounded 2*tanh(raw/2)
writer.centering: subtract the differentiable mean coefficient over all fixed 144 training events in canonical segment-ID order on every forward
writer.centering_effect: the mean trainable residual latent over the fixed training set is identically zero for every parameter state
writer.basis_normalization: unit L2 per basis at every forward
writer.step0_reconstruction: fixed base plus centered residual exactly reconstructs each R12 conditioned endpoint latent up to floating-point tolerance

training_pairing.construction: deterministically pair the 36 equal-size target-value groups into 18 pairs, then pair their four members bijectively; every event appears once as own and once as donor in the opposite direction whenever its partner is scheduled
training_pairing.evaluation_donor_mapping: unchanged R12 per-split donor_derangement; training pairing does not replace or tune the evaluation donor

optimization.choice_views: unchanged R12 schedule: each segment receives each forward-cyclic view exactly eight times
optimization.ranking_margin_reason: donor_CE >= own_CE + ln(4) implies donor target probability <= own target probability/4 <= 1/4, so a wrong-donor image cannot make the anchor target the uniquely preferred four-choice answer; the hinge stops pushing once this condition holds
optimization.latent_rms_penalty_implementation: stable value-equivalent thresholded RMS form inherited from R12
optimization.primary_endpoint: raw symmetric donor-ranked centered writer step1152

conditions.normal: fixed common base plus the target event's centered residual
conditions.donor: fixed common base plus a fixed different-target-value event's centered residual
conditions.base: the frozen R12 common visual base with zero conditional residual

evaluation.adaptive_reuse_disclosure: all four R14 evaluation subsets are reused unchanged from R13 for a controlled objective-only comparison; no R14 development gradients or checkpoint selection are allowed, but an independent sealed confirmation is required after any candidate pass

locked_interpretation.all_four_splits_pass: Symmetric donor ranking resolves the R13 attribution failure on the fixed comparison suite. Treat this only as a candidate one-SET mechanism: require a newly sealed fixed-full-data ID/OOD multi-seed confirmation before recurrence or any success claim.
locked_interpretation.train_pass_heldout_fail: The ranked centered writer fits held-in events but its event-to-code map does not generalize across the reused held-out entities; improve the conditional representation/map before recurrence.
locked_interpretation.train_fail: Even explicit symmetric donor-ranking cannot fit the fixed one-SET causal boundary under the centered architecture; diagnose whether the frozen event representation, low-dimensional code basis, or optimization geometry blocks separable codes before preregistering the next minimal intervention.
locked_interpretation.donor_or_base_gate_fail: Any apparent reset improvement is a non-causal generic-code effect or harmful donor artifact; false positive, no advance.
locked_interpretation.technical_failure: Rerun only after correcting the invalid execution; make no scientific inference.

success_boundary.formal_success_still_requires: a newly sealed fixed-full-data ID/OOD evaluation, multiple seeds, shared recurrence, overwrite/clear/interference, and causal state controls
